ReleaseNote:
- Included AfxHookGoldSrc 2.26.0 (2026-11-06T23:30Z)
- Included AfxHookSource 1.136.0 (2026-11-06T23:30Z)
- Included AfxHookSource2 0.42.0 (2026-11-06T23:30Z)

## AfxHookGoldSrc 2.26.0 & AfxHookSource 1.136.0 & AfxHookSource2 0.42.0
- Breaking change: `mirv_streams ffmpeg options` now use `{{` for `{` and `}}` for `}` (was `{` and `}`). The `\\` is no longer turned into single `\`, so use a single `\` now.
- Added `{AFX_OUTPUT_FILE}`  to `mirv_streams ffmpeg options`, and the default options and afxFfmpeg* presets now use it. `{AFX_STREAM_PATH}` is now the folder of the output file. See more info on [the wiki page.](https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx/wiki/HLAE-recording-path-reference)

## AfxHookSource 1.136.0 & AfxHookSource2 0.42.0
- Added mirv_streams output path templates:  `mirv_streams record take`, `record cam path`, `record campath path`, `record startMovieWavPath` and `settings edit settingsName path`. See more info on [the wiki page.](https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx/wiki/HLAE-recording-path-reference)
- Added `mirv_streams record screen name` to set `{STREAM_NAME}` for the screen recording (default: screen).
- Added more prores ffmpeg presets, see [details on wiki.](https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx/wiki/HLAE-recording-path-reference#included-ffmpeg-presets)
- Changed `afxFfmpegProres` and `afxFfmpegProresAlpha` to use `-q:v 9`. Now it's faster and produce smaller files, but not bitrate compliant with Apple spec. More details on [wiki page.](https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx/wiki/HLAE-recording-path-reference#included-ffmpeg-presets)
- Fixed possible race condition in `mirv_streams record startMovieWav` when determining the WAV file path (in AfxHookSource, non-CS:GO games only).

## AfxHookSource 1.136.0
- Added `mirv_streams record agr path`, `record bvh cam path`, `record bvh ent path` and `record voices path` (CS:GO). Entity BVH and voices paths require the new `{ENTITY_INDEX}` variable. More details on [wiki page.](https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx/wiki/HLAE-recording-path-reference#afxhooksource)
- `mirv_streams record bvh cam` and `record voices` now only accept a number as value.
- `mirv_voice record start` without folder now records into the current folder as documented.

## AfxHookSource2 0.42.0
- Added `mirv_streams preview`
- Added `mirv_streams edit streamName scopeAction`
- Added `mirv_streams edit streamName actionFilter`
- Added `mirv_streams picker`, [see wiki](https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx/wiki/Source2%3Amirv_streams#editing-streams)
- Colored smokes (with `mirv_colors`) now retain their color while fading out.
- Fixed `mirv_streams record start` behaviour when fps is not set, no more error spam.
- Added `getParentHandle()` and `getRootHandle()` to mirv-script entities.
- Added `mirv_script_record_name` mirv-script snippet, which updates recording paths to a more convenient layout using new templating system. See example on [wiki page.](https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx/wiki/HLAE-recording-path-reference#custom-layout-with-mirv-script-for-afxhooksource2)
- Increased highest entity index to 0x7FFF, related to `mirv_listentities` and mirv-script `getHighestEntityIndex()`
- Fixed `mirv.events` type definitions in mirv-script
- Fixed undefined behaviour in interpolation_amount_get. Thanks @Co1Swet 

Credit for this update *mostly* goes to @dtugend
